name: Warren Buffett
style: Long-term value; buys whole businesses and large stakes in quality companies
follow: 13F (quarterly, ≤45 days); Form 4 within 2 business days on stakes above 10%; annual letter and meeting

name: Stanley Druckenmiller
style: Global macro; concentrated, fast-changing bets driven by liquidity and rates

name: Bill Ackman
style: Concentrated activist; 8–12 large positions in high-quality companies
follow: 13F; 13D within 5 business days; posts on X; weekly NAV of Pershing Square Holdings

name: David Tepper
style: Opportunistic; buys distressed or out-of-favour assets and big macro turning points

name: Seth Klarman
style: Deep value with a 'margin of safety'; often holds large cash and illiquid assets

name: Carl Icahn
style: Activist; takes big stakes and pushes for board seats, sales or buybacks
follow: 13D within 5 business days; Form 4 within 2 business days; IEP quarterly results

name: Li Lu
style: Very concentrated long-term value, US and Asia; few trades

name: Howard Marks
style: Credit and distressed-debt investing; market-cycle thinking
follow: Free memos (several a year); Brookfield/Oaktree filings
